items.markdown:
Forehead wrinkles are `lines or creases that form on the upper face as a result of repeated muscle movements and the natural aging process`.[[1]](https://www.avene.com.au/your-skin/skin-ageing/understanding-skin-ageing/understanding-wrinkles/forehead-wrinkles)[[2]](https://forefrontdermatology.com/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)

### Causes

- **Facial expressions:** Raising your eyebrows or frowning repeatedly uses the frontalis muscle, creating dynamic lines that deepen over time.[[1]](https://www.germainedecapuccini.com/uk_en/blog/posts/forehead-wrinkles)
- **Loss of collagen:** Natural production of collagen and elastin slows down starting in your mid-20s, reducing skin firmness and elasticity.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.com/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)[[2]](https://www.germainedecapuccini.com/uk_en/blog/posts/forehead-wrinkles)
- **UV exposure:** Sunlight breaks down collagen fibers in the skin, which accelerates premature aging.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.com/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)[[2]](https://www.germainedecapuccini.com/uk_en/blog/posts/forehead-wrinkles)
- **Dehydration and lifestyle:** Dry skin, smoking, and stress make fine lines more noticeable and permanent.[[1]](https://uk.caudalie.com/articles-premier-cru/deep-forehead-wrinkles)[[2]](https://www.germainedecapuccini.com/uk_en/blog/posts/forehead-wrinkles)

### Prevention

- **Wear sunscreen:** Apply a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher daily to protect collagen from UV damage.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.com/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)
- **Stay hydrated:** Drink plenty of water and use a daily moisturiser to maintain skin plumpness.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.com/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)
- **Manage screen habits:** Reduce squinting by adjusting screen brightness or wearing protective glasses.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.com/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)

### Treatments

- **Topical skincare:** Use creams and serums containing retinoids, hyaluronic acid, or peptides to boost hydration and support collagen.
- **Injectables:** [Botox](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/10984-wrinkles) (neuromodulators) relaxes the underlying muscles to soften dynamic lines, while dermal fillers restore volume to deeper creases.
- **Resurfacing procedures:** Laser treatments, chemical peels, and microdermabrasion remove damaged outer skin layers to encourage regeneration.
- **At-home care:** Silicone patches like those from [Wrinkles Schminkles UK](https://wrinklesschminkles.co.uk/collections/forehead-patches) can help smooth the look of lines temporarily.[[1]](https://wrinklesschminkles.co.uk/collections/forehead-patches)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/10984-wrinkles)[[3]](https://uk.caudalie.com/articles-resveratrol-lift/forehead-wrinkles)[[4]](https://www.goldenstatedermatology.com/blog/say-goodbye-to-forehead-wrinkles-and-hello-to-smoothed-lines/)[[5]](https://www.cadoganclinic.com/ask-the-expert/facial-treatments/forehead-wrinkles-frown-lines)

If you want, let me know:

- Are the lines **visible at rest** or only when you move your face?
- What **skincare products** do you currently use?

I can help you build a routine or explore treatment options.
